description: Run the student's application past prefrosh.ai's simulated admissions committee for one college and round: five fictional readers (first, second, essay and faculty readers, and a dean who chairs) read it, argue, vote (accept / waitlist or defer / deny), and give the top 3 fixes. It is a simulation, not a prediction. Takes about a minute; the room plays out in the view. Pass the student's own application text exactly as they gave it (essays, activities, grades, scores) in "application"; never write, invent or improve content for them. If they have not shared their application, ask them to paste it first.

application.description: The student's application as they gave it: essays, activities, grades, scores, notes. Verbatim.

visited_campus.description: Campus visits, if the student said.
